$description: What each Briareus client offers, feature by feature, against the server API (/api/v1). Support is full, partial, none, or n/a (the platform cannot, not merely does not). Audited from each client's code on 2026-10-11, and against the server's /api/v1 through core #162 on 2026-10-15; update it in the same pull request that adds or removes a feature in a client.

features.title: Pair with a device token
features.description: Connect to an HTTPS server with a per-device token kept in the OS secure store.

notes.ios: CarPlay cannot pair; the phone does.

features.title: Adapt to server and token
features.description: Controls the server lacks, or the token may not call, are hidden or disabled (Read-only tokens can't write).

features.title: Revoke token from the app
features.description: Revoke this device's token on the server, not just forget it locally.

notes.windows: Sign-out forgets the token locally without revoking it on the server.
notes.mac: Sign-out (Store.forget) is local only; revoke_token is in the core table but unused by the Mac UI.

features.title: Saved state and incremental resume
features.description: Screens open on cached projects, conversations and transcripts, then fetch only what changed.

notes.quest: Encrypted on the headset.

features.title: Live session updates
features.description: Session lists and transcripts update in real time over server-sent events.

notes.windows: Polls with backoff; never opens /events or /sessions/{id}/events.
notes.ios: Foreground only: iOS closes the streams in the background and they catch up on return; polling carries on where the server lacks them.

features.title: Self-update
features.description: Checks GitHub releases, verifies and installs updates.

notes.ios: Distributed via App Store/TestFlight.
notes.quest: Sideloaded APK with no updater; Android could install updates.

features.title: Projects and conversations
features.description: Browse the token's projects and their conversations with state, provider, branch and age.

notes.quest: Also nests orchestrator workers and counts what waits per project.

features.title: Bulk close/delete
features.description: Tick several conversations and close or delete them at once.

features.title: Start a conversation
features.description: Start a session on a chosen branch, provider, model and effort, or the project default, optionally with the review loop.

features.title: Worktree / Local / Orchestrator
features.description: Choose the workspace mode, including a local checkout or an orchestrator that runs workers.

notes.ios: No workspace picker; README says epics/orchestrators are started from the Mac.

features.title: Incremental transcript
features.description: Read the transcript with message times, agent questions and queued messages, appended incrementally.

features.title: Markdown replies
features.description: Agent replies render as Markdown (headings, lists, tables, code with copy, links); text is selectable.

notes.ios: Tables also copy whole as Markdown.
notes.mac: Tables also copy whole as Markdown.

features.title: Collapsible tool activity
features.description: Tool calls, commands and git steps fold into expandable clusters between messages.

features.title: Session details panel
features.description: See the conversation's pull request, checks, reviews, findings and context use beside it.

notes.ios: As a sheet rather than a side panel.
notes.quest: Opens the PR in a browser panel; no details side panel.

features.title: Task cost history
features.description: Open a task's history: every session filed under it and their combined cost.

features.title: Send follow-ups
features.description: Send a message into the running turn or the queue.

features.title: Attach files
features.description: Paste, drop or pick files/images that upload and go with the message.

notes.quest: System file picker only.

features.title: Voice notes
features.description: Record audio and have the server transcribe it into the message box.

notes.quest: Primary input (no keyboard); read-only text area to check before sending.

features.title: Take back queued messages
features.description: Remove a queued message before the agent receives it.

features.title: Answer agent questions
features.description: Answer an agent's question with one of its offered options.

notes.quest: Also from notifications and the status panel.

features.title: Saved prompt library
features.description: Insert, save and delete prompts from the project's prompt library.

features.title: Side question (/btw)
features.description: Ask a side question about a session the agent never sees.

notes.mac: Sends a message starting with /btw (the server answers it the same way) rather than POST /sessions/{id}/btw; the question and answer show in the transcript.

features.title: Stop a turn
features.description: Cancel the running turn.

features.title: Close, reopen, delete
features.description: Close a session, reopen it later, or delete it.

features.title: Rename
features.description: Rename a session.

notes.quest: No PATCH /sessions route in the client.

features.title: Compact and clear
features.description: Compact a session's context or clear its transcript.

features.title: Review loop toggle
features.description: Arm or disarm the automatic review loop on a session.

features.title: QA loop toggle
features.description: Arm automatic QA after the review loop passes.

notes.windows: Route is in core/api.c's table but no screen calls it.

features.title: Link a pull request
features.description: Attach a PR to a session after the server checks the branch.

notes.windows: Route is in the table but unused by the UI.

features.title: Recover interrupted session
features.description: Inspect what an interrupted session left in its workspace and resume from it.

features.title: Session webhook
features.description: Arm a session's webhook, set caps (Turns in a row 0 for no limit), copy URLs/keys and rotate keys (Admin).

notes.windows: Turns in a row still takes 1 to 1000; the server takes 0 for no limit since core #158.

features.title: Session mail wake
features.description: Set the rules under which new inbox mail in a connected mailbox wakes a session (mailbox, To/Cc, From, Subject), with Wakes an hour and Turns in a row caps (Admin, projects with mail tools on).

notes.ios: The iPhone app has no mail features to pick a rule's mailbox from.

features.title: Pull request list
features.description: List open PRs with checks, conflicts, labels, people, linked issues and stack, filtered by author/reviewer/label.

notes.quest: Filters by author or label only.

features.title: PR overview
features.description: Open a PR on its description, checks, reviews, commits, linked issues and prior conversations.

features.title: Files changed and diffs
features.description: Browse a PR's changed files with diffs.

notes.quest: pull_files is only used by the voice assistant to summarize changes; no diff UI.

features.title: PR comments and review threads
features.description: Read the PR's comments, reviews and inline review comments as a timeline.

notes.quest: Review summary from the overview only.

features.title: Run preview
features.description: Serve a PR's branch and view the running app in an embedded browser, with Cloudflare Access handled.

notes.quest: Preview opens in its own panel.

features.title: Run default branch
features.description: Serve the project's default branch (with a run profile) from the project screen.

features.title: Annotated preview feedback
features.description: Mark a point on a preview screenshot and send it to the agent as feedback.

features.title: Errands
features.description: Start code review, solve conflicts, fix checks, implement feedback, test sheet, record QA and other errands; the suggested one is highlighted.

features.title: Merge
features.description: Merge a PR at the head read, after being told what stands in the way.

notes.ios: Also by swipe on the list row.

features.title: Edit PR/issue and update branch
features.description: Edit title, Markdown body, labels and assignees (incl. Assign me) on GitHub, and merge the base into a PR (Update branch).

features.title: Review List
features.description: A tab of PRs waiting on your review (required-dev-review / feedback-implemented).

features.title: QA recordings
features.description: Play the videos a Record QA run captured.

features.title: Findings queue
features.description: See every review round awaiting a decision across projects, grouped by PR, with a count.

notes.quest: No cross-project findings screen; rounds surface as conversation states, notifications and the status panel.

features.title: Triage a held round
features.description: Give each finding a verdict and comment, add a note and complete the round into the fix session.

notes.quest: Completes the round (triage) but never saves verdicts to the PR (findings/save).

features.title: Reply/delete on others' reviews
features.description: On a review of someone else's PR, reply on finding threads or delete findings.

features.title: Decide findings on a PR page
features.description: Record fix/optional/dismiss on a PR's findings from the PR page and solve them.

notes.quest: Findings are listed read-only on the PR page; no decision route.

features.title: SSH and Slack approvals
features.description: Approve or deny agents' pending SSH commands and Slack posts.

notes.mac: On the Findings screen, Admin token.

features.title: Issue list
features.description: List open issues with sub-issues under epics and answering PRs, filtered by author/assignee/label.

notes.quest: Only via the voice assistant's list_issues tool.

features.title: Issue page
features.description: Open an issue with body, sub-issues, fields, linked PRs and paged timeline.

notes.windows: Opens in a side panel over the board/PR.
notes.quest: Voice reads issues; 'show issue' opens GitHub in the browser.

features.title: Start a session on an issue
features.description: Start an agent on an issue at a tap.

notes.quest: Voice only (work_on_issue).

features.title: Close an issue
features.description: Close as completed or not planned, with an optional comment.

features.title: GitHub Projects board
features.description: View the project's GitHub Projects board by column and drag cards between columns.

notes.ios: README: 'The GitHub Projects board stays on the Mac app.'

features.title: Repository file browser
features.description: Browse the repository tree at a branch and open files with highlighting, via the server's GitHub token.

notes.mac: Also downloads /repo/archive for a local index.

features.title: Laravel Forge sites
features.description: Browse Forge servers/sites for the project and edit deploy script and .env.

features.title: GitHub deployments
features.description: See deployments per environment and plan/dispatch a deploy.

features.title: Envoyer accounts & deployments
features.description: Manage Envoyer accounts, list projects, servers and deployments, and trigger a deploy.

features.title: Agent memories
features.description: List, edit, add and delete what agents remember; health report to verify/merge (Admin).

features.title: Spend dashboard
features.description: See spend over a window by project, activity, provider and model, with costliest sessions and filters.

notes.windows: Needs an Admin token (/usage/all only); others are told so.
notes.ios: Non-admin tokens see this month's own spend.

features.title: Provider quotas
features.description: See each provider account's login state and quota windows.

notes.windows: Per provider on its Settings Status tab only.
notes.ios: On the Usage tab, and per provider in Settings.

features.title: Projects settings
features.description: Create, edit, clone, delete and reorder projects with all their tabs (Admin).

features.title: Providers settings
features.description: Manage providers, their models, logins and endpoint tests (Admin).

features.title: Database pool
features.description: Manage and test the database servers sessions claim (Admin).

features.title: SSH servers
features.description: Manage SSH servers agents may use, with their stored DB login (Admin).

features.title: Forge accounts
features.description: Manage Laravel Forge accounts and their projects (Admin).

features.title: Slack workspaces
features.description: Manage Slack workspaces and each project's channels/approval (Admin).

features.title: Mail accounts
features.description: Connect, sync, relabel and disconnect mailboxes (Admin).

features.title: MCP servers
features.description: Manage the operator MCP registry and sign in to servers (Admin).

features.title: Server administration
features.description: Drain for maintenance, manage workspace slots, edit prompt templates and update a project's checkout (Admin).

features.title: Devices & tokens
features.description: List, issue or revoke other devices' tokens.

notes.windows: No /api/v1 route; tokens are issued on the server with npm run create-token.
notes.ios: No /api/v1 route.
notes.quest: No /api/v1 route.

features.title: Background notifications
features.description: Get OS notifications when an agent asks, a turn finishes, findings are held or a session fails.

notes.ios: No push in the API (would need APNs); iOS can't hold /events open in the background.
notes.quest: Foreground service keeps /events open.

features.title: Reply from notification
features.description: Answer with one tap on the agent's options or Continue without opening the app.

features.title: Waiting/working overview
features.description: See counts of waiting, working and ready sessions and answer waiting ones in place.

notes.windows: Only a findings count in the sidebar.
notes.mac: ◉ Status in the sidebar strip, its badge the count needing you; answers questions in place.
notes.ios: ◉ Status at the top of the Findings tab, whose badge is the count needing you; answers questions in place.
notes.quest: Dedicated status panel.

features.title: GPT-Realtime voice assistant
features.description: Hold a spoken conversation that reads and acts on projects, PRs, issues and conversations, with confirmation and cost.

notes.ios: Scoped to one project; works with the phone locked.
notes.quest: Across all projects, and also drives the panels ('show me this PR').

features.title: Hands-free conversation line
features.description: Talk to one conversation's agent by voice and hear its replies and questions read aloud.

notes.quest: The global assistant can answer an agent, but there is no dedicated per-conversation read-aloud line.

features.title: Meeting assistant
features.description: An ElevenLabs agent joins your meeting through a virtual mic and answers project questions with read-only tools.

notes.ios: iOS can't capture other apps' audio or provide a virtual microphone.
notes.quest: Android can't capture meeting apps' audio or inject a virtual mic.

features.title: CarPlay
features.description: Drive conversations, PRs and issues by dictation in CarPlay.

notes.quest: No CarPlay on Quest.

features.title: Watch and drive the shared browser
features.description: Switch on the session's headless Chromium, watch it live and click/type on the agent's tabs.

notes.windows: Docks beside the conversation, resizes, expands or pops out to its own window.
notes.mac: Docks/pops out like Windows; also uses GET /sessions/{id}/browser/screenshot.
notes.ios: Full screen only (no docking).
notes.quest: Not built.

features.title: SSH terminal
features.description: Open SSH sessions to a project's servers in a built-in terminal using local ssh and keys.

notes.ios: Excluded (needs the Mac's ssh); possible with an embedded SSH library.
notes.quest: Not built; Android could embed an SSH client.

features.title: SFTP file browser
features.description: Browse, upload, download, rename and delete files over SFTP.

notes.ios: Not built (needs local sftp).
notes.quest: Not built.

features.title: Database browser
features.description: Browse a server's MySQL databases, tables and rows over SSH with the stored DB login.

features.title: Mail inbox
features.description: Read synced mail across accounts with filters, search and threads, reply in plain text in the thread, and delete a message to provider trash.

notes.windows: Reply at provider opens the provider's website; it does not call the reply route (core #152).

features.title: WhatsApp
features.description: Read and send WhatsApp chats.

notes.windows: Embeds web.whatsapp.com in WebView2; the server's /whatsapp API is not used.
notes.mac: Embeds WhatsApp Web; /whatsapp API not used.

features.title: Slack inbox
features.description: Read Slack conversations and threads, open DMs and send messages.

features.title: List beside conversation
features.description: Projects/conversations column beside the chosen conversation, collapsing to one column when narrow.

notes.ios: iPad only; iPhone is single-column.

features.title: Detached windows / panels
features.description: Pop a conversation, findings, dashboard or browser into its own window/panel.

notes.ios: iPad only (Open in New Window); an iPhone has one window.
notes.quest: Conversations, preview and status as separate panels.

features.title: Search conversations
features.description: Filter the conversation list by text.

notes.windows: README claims search, but no list filter exists in code (Ctrl+F only works inside a conversation).

features.title: Find in conversation
features.description: Ctrl/⌘+F highlights matches in a transcript and steps through them.

features.title: Code search & navigation
features.description: PhpStorm-style Go to File/Class/Symbol and Find in Files over an indexed repository.

notes.mac: Adds Search Everywhere, Go to Declaration, Find Usages and regex search.

features.title: Home Assistant connection
features.description: Check the server-configured bridge with an admin token; proposed UI, no client implementation.

features.title: Home Assistant entities
features.description: Browse and filter entities, inspect their states and attributes, and poll while visible; proposed UI.

features.title: Home Assistant actions
features.description: Discover services, send service data, and inspect receipts without automatic retries; proposed UI.

features.title: Home Assistant events
features.description: Send an event to an existing Home Assistant automation; proposed UI, no event subscription.

features.title: Menu device status
features.description: Proposed collapsible menu block for local CPU, memory, and battery readings; telemetry is not implemented by this change.

notes.windows: Proposed This computer block with available CPU, memory, and battery readings.
notes.mac: Same proposed desktop layout as Windows.
notes.ios: Proposed This device block, battery first; omit metrics the OS cannot supply.
notes.quest: Proposed This device block with headset.type sizing; omit unsupported metrics.

unused_api.note: Admin-only bridge merged in Core #147; proposed client wireframes, support checked on 2026-10-12.
Publish a downloadable session file (core #149); assistant links to workspace files already arrive as download URLs.
CPU, memory, process and disk figures per session and for the server, with an hour of history (core #160).
